content: Hello! how can I help today?
I had a major business loss last year. Can I use it this year?
Yes. Net Operating Losses (**NOLs**) can be **carried forward indefinitely** under **IRC §172**, though they’re limited to **80% of taxable income** in the carryforward year.

1. Calculate NOL on **Schedule A of Form 1045**
2. Carry it forward via **Schedule B, Form 1045**, and attach to this year’s return
3. Apply the NOL deduction on **Form 1040, Line 8b**
Can I still carry it back instead?
No—carrybacks were suspended after 2020 for most taxpayers. You must carry forward unless it’s a **farming loss or insurance company**.
Yes—NOLs may be adjusted for AMT. Ensure coordination with **Form 6251** if you’re subject to AMT rules.
